_comment: Per-ticker crawl sources for npm run crawl (PLAN §1 feeds.json). Discovery only: candidates become evidence only via add_source / add_research_note. Every listing URL, redirect hop and candidate link must pass config/domain-policy.json + company ir_domains (config/companies.json). SEC needs SP_HTTP_UA (your contact) in .env; it is never stored here.

AAPL.note: Apple Newsroom (press releases incl. quarterly results) on apple.com (AAPL IR domain)

AMZN.note: About Amazon news (company news incl. quarterly results); ir.aboutamazon.com answered 403 to automated requests on 2026-10-31

GOOGL.note: Alphabet investor relations; answered 403 (bot wall) to automated requests on 2026-10-31. Earnings releases are PDFs (not citable as pages); use SEC 8-K EX-99.1 once SP_HTTP_UA is set
Google's official blog (blog.google, a GOOGL IR domain in companies.json since abc.xyz returns 403): product, AI and earnings-call posts
